```{python}
#| echo: false

import folium

m = folium.Map(
    location=[48.5, 9.5],
    zoom_start=5,
    tiles=None,
    zoom_control=False,
    scrollWheelZoom=False,
    dragging=True
)

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles="https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_nolabels/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png",
    attr='CartoDB',
    name="CartoDB Positron"
).add_to(m)

# Main locations (larger markers)
locations = {
    "Basel": {"coords": [47.5596, 7.5886], "radius": 14},
    "Freiburg": {"coords": [47.9945, 7.8470], "radius": 8},
    "Milan": {"coords": [45.4511, 9.1886], "radius": 9},
    "Frankfurt": {"coords": [50.1109, 8.6821], "radius": 8},
    "Donaueschingen": {"coords": [47.9511, 8.4902], "radius": 7},
    "Freising": {"coords": [48.4028, 11.7489], "radius": 7},
    "Konstanz": {"coords": [47.6633, 9.1751], "radius": 7},
}

for city, info in locations.items():
    folium.CircleMarker(
        location=info["coords"],
        radius=info["radius"],
        stroke=True,
        color="#ffffff",
        weight=2,
        fill=True,
        fill_color="#6B4E9B",
        fill_opacity=0.9,
        tooltip=city
    ).add_to(m)

# Conference locations (smaller markers)
conferences = {
    "London": [51.5072, -0.1276],
    "Wengen": [46.6054, 7.9217],
    "Würzburg": [49.7945, 9.9294],
    "Bayreuth": [49.9422, 11.5806],
    "The Hague": [52.0705, 4.3007],
    "Berlin": [52.5200, 13.4050],
    "Gengenbach": [48.4035, 8.0185],
    "Budapest": [47.4979, 19.0402],
    "Chișinău": [47.0105, 28.8638],
    "Eindhoven": [51.4416, 5.4697],
}

for city, coords in conferences.items():
    folium.CircleMarker(
        location=coords,
        radius=4,
        stroke=True,
        color="#ffffff",
        weight=1,
        fill=True,
        fill_color="#6B4E9B",
        fill_opacity=0.7,
        tooltip=city
    ).add_to(m)
```
